newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Trust, NatWest Gartmore in fund tie-up.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Trust, NatWest Gartmore in fund tie-up.

text.p: Sumitomo Trust & Banking Co Ltd will tie up with a Japanese unit of British investment firm Gartmore Investment Management to strengthen its pension fund management in European equities, officials at the two companies said on Wednesday.
Sumitomo Trust and NatWest Gartmore Investment Management Japan Limited will sign a contract on the business tie-up later today, the officials said.
Gartmore Investment is a unit of National Westminster Bank Plc.
Under the contract, NatWest Gartmore will provide investment information on European equities, including stock valuations, in return for investment advisory fees.
With this agreement, Sumitomo Trust hopes to enhance its expertise in selecting European stocks, a Sumitomo Trust official said.
Sumitomo Trust has about two trillion yen in assets invested in 25 foreign countries, including 14 European countries.
The bank currently has some 800 billion yen in pension fund and public fund money invested in Europe.
